scope: Exploratory diagnostic specified after the same sample produced no admitted trades and62 large-flow bins. Prior sample outcomes and liquidity distributions known; not prospective validation. No parameter search and no cash-PnL claim.
selection: All ordinary prints with valid source age<=2s and a prior fresh paired quote:both book sources strictly before print source, no more than250ms earlier, receipt point no later than print receipt. Keep prints whose quantity>=25%displayed same-side depth within5bp of own best. No activity baseline or price/future-return gate. Max2000 candidate rows perasset; capfails whole output, no selective dropping.
observation: First fresh paired quote after candidate becomes observable, with both book sources>=print source and decision clock within250ms of print receipt. Prices already known at receipt are allowed when source constraints pass. Record local impact and reference movement;>=2bp aligned local impact and<=1bp reference move is a diagnostic label only. Horizons100,400,1000,5000,10000,30000ms from decision; both source and receipt timestamps>=due, first fresh pair bydue+250ms. Missing, late, invalidated and unanchored candidates retained. No exact100ms claim when actual recorded delay is longer.
returns: Fade sign opposite aggressor, log-midpoint returns on target and relative to other venue. Report all selected candidates regardless initial impact. Remaining fade after400ms only when both endpoints matched; uses actual recorded endpoints. Overlapping dependent observations, possible print fragmentation, source-time uncertainty and no causal attribution. No fees, spread subtraction, fill model or profitability estimate.
tests: Four synthetic timing/depth tests passed:strict pre source and quarter-depth boundary;both source/receipt post horizon;late baseline;invalidation and zero-impact retention.
